PHYSICS — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electromagnetic induction? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electromagnetic induction.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electromagnetic induction.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electromagnetic induction.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Electromagnetic induction.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Floating and Sinking? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Floating and Sinking.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Floating and Sinking.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Floating and Sinking.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Floating and Sinking.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites.

4. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Circular motion? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Circular motion.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Circular motion.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Circular motion.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Circular motion.

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

8. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dynamics? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dynamics.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dynamics.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dynamics.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Dynamics.

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Quantity of Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Quantity of Heat.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Quantity of Heat.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Quantity of Heat.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Quantity of Heat.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transistors? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transistors.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transistors.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transistors.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Transistors.

14. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

15. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mains electricity? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Mains electricity.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mains electricity.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mains electricity.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mains electricity.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Floating and Sinking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Quantity of Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Thin lenses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Photoelectric effect and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Electromagnetic induction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Mains electricity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
